verses.html: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
verses.text: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
verses.title: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.

verses.html: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
verses.text: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

verses.html: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
verses.text: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

verses.html: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
verses.text: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

verses.html: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
verses.text: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

verses.html: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?
verses.text: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?

verses.html: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
verses.text: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

verses.html: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
verses.text: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

verses.html: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
verses.text: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

verses.html: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
verses.text: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

verses.html: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
verses.text: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

verses.html: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
verses.text: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

verses.html: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
verses.text: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

verses.html: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
verses.text: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

verses.html: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
verses.text: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.

verses.html: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
verses.text: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

verses.html: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
verses.text: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

verses.html: For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.
verses.text: For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

verses.html: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
verses.text: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

verses.html: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
verses.text: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

verses.html: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.text: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

verses.html: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.text: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

verses.html: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
verses.text: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

verses.html: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.text: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

verses.html: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
verses.text: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

verses.html: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
verses.text: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

verses.html: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
verses.text: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

verses.html: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
verses.text: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

verses.html: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.text: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

verses.html: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
verses.text: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

verses.html: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
verses.text: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

verses.html: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.text: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

verses.html: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
verses.text: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

verses.html: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
verses.text: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

verses.html: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
verses.text: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

verses.html: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
verses.text: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

verses.html: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
verses.text: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

verses.html: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
verses.text: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

verses.html: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
verses.text: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

verses.html: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
verses.text: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

verses.html: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
verses.text: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

verses.html: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
verses.text: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

verses.html: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
verses.text: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

verses.html: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.text: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

verses.html: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.text: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

verses.html: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
verses.text: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

verses.html: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
verses.text: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

verses.html: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
verses.text: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

verses.html: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
verses.text: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

verses.html: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
verses.text: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;

verses.html: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
verses.text: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

verses.html: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
verses.text: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
